reportHeader: Active Design in Midtown (CD5) Active Design Active Design Guidelines 2.0: Designing for Health and Equity (ADG 2.0) is a playbook and toolkit to equitably improve the health of New Yorkers through the design of the city’s built environment. The guidelines focus on the buildings, streets and neighborhoods where we live, work and play—and the significant impact these spaces have on our daily lives.
